$Comment: MMO Skill Tree's half of the Christmas Set, Christmas_Set.json. Joins adds this file to that set instead
of making a set of its own, so the player still sees one Christmas Set: one notice, one entry. The set's
name and members stay that file's, so this file names none.
Its two tiers ask exactly what the set's two tiers ask (Armor 2, then Armor 4), so each joins its twin:
its stats apply beside the set's, and its line follows the set's line in the same notice. A tier asking
for something else would be added as a tier of its own. Requires takes this file out on a server without
MMO Skill Tree, where these stats do not exist and its lines would name a bonus nobody gets; always write
MMO_BonusXp_WOODCUTTING raises the Woodcutting XP the wearer earns and MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING the luck
Woodcutting's lucky rolls read, both in whole percent points (10 is 10%). The luck also raises the
Winter Bauble find while Christmas runs (Factors/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Bauble_Luck.json). Both
are Additive on purpose: these channels have a base of zero, so a Multiplicative entry computes nothing.
